title.narrative: Justice Dashboard EaP

description.narrative: The overall objective is to support the EaP countries in their efforts to achieve an effective, systematic and data-based monitoring and evaluation of the results of the judicial reform efforts. Annual collection and processing of data will be carried out on the functioning of the judicial systems, including prosecution services. This evaluation tool will use key performance indicators concerning the accountability, quality and efficiency of the judicial systems and prosecution services.
